readerAnswers.event: China’s Foreign Ministry responded on September 14 to calls by AI company leaders to slow development.
readerAnswers.disagreement: El País reports that Amodei, Anthropic’s chief executive, also called for keeping China from accessing the most advanced chips and chipmaking equipment.
readerAnswers.effect: Guo’s quoted answer sets out China’s position on cooperation.

terms.AI governance: how AI development is guided by rules and oversight

explainBack: Guo called for open inclusive AI and criticized fear-mongering. That records China’s position in response to slowdown calls; it does not establish agreed slowdown or a requirement taking effect.
unseenTransfer: If another government says it supports safe AI, I would look for an exact requirement, who it applies to and enforcement evidence before calling that statement an implemented rule.
repairsMade: Defined the necessary governance term at first use after producer mechanical preflight exposed the missing definition. No independent cycle spent.
limitations: Producer AI simulation; no observed human reader evidence.
